item.title: [NH] NH Education Deep Dive — The Burden Shift: How HB 581 Rewrote the Rules of Special Ed Disputes in New Hampshire
item.description:

Alex and Jordan break down HB 581 — what changed, what it means for parents and districts, and what it demands of NH special education teams in their daily work. Educational guidance, not legal advice.
